The '''All Terrain Cruiser K-111''' was a model of [[steam rover]]. The vehicle was manufactured by [[Barimoq Industries]]. [[Ansan Talam]] owned a K-111, being forced to purchase one after losing his [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] to a [[Tunnel worm (Tasariq)|tunnel worm]] attack.<ref name="J15" />
